summary: FINAL consolidated QA for CareSync. Ran all 7 requested scenarios end-to-end. Backend: new consolidated pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa.py = 19/19 passing on two consecutive runs (patient booking E2E + double-book 409, doctor weekly-schedule save/restore + validation + exception add/delete + cross-doctor 403, admin private-by-default upload -> release -> byte-exact patient download, report security matrix 404/403/401/200, patient-document upload+admin review+doctor 403, rescheduling flow with affected count / needs_rescheduling / notification content / empty slots / row preserved / rebook, health + env). Frontend (Playwright, public preview URL): patient login -> dashboard -> doctors (5 cards) -> booking dialog with 14 date options -> live slots -> booking-confirmation shown -> appointment persists after reload with status badge -> notifications render (30 rows incl. 'Appointment confirmed'); doctor login -> Availability page 7 day cards, duration 45 saved + verified after reload + restored, exception added and deleted; admin login -> Reports page upload (message 'Report uploaded privately'), release-report -> row shows 'Released', accept-document -> 'accepted', Availability shows schedule-doctor-select with 5 doctors and 7 day cards on switch; needs_rescheduling appointment shows amber badge + working Rebook link. Mobile 375/390: zero document-level horizontal overflow on /, /login, /app, /app/doctors (+dialog), /app/appointments, /app/records, /app/schedule (1 column), /app/uploads, /app/notifications; 1280 keeps 3-column schedule. Infra: /api/health = healthy/emergent/active, all env vars present, `yarn build` succeeded (exit 0), backend startup clean apart from the known benign passlib bcrypt-version trap. Auth spot-checks: all password hashes $2b$, cookie HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None, brute-force 401x5 then 429. One functional defect found (past-dated bookings accepted) plus several cosmetic/product-polish issues; all QA data cleaned up.

critical.issue: No past-time/past-date guard. GET /api/slots for TODAY returns already-elapsed times as available (at 15:46 UTC it returned 09:00-16:30 all available), and POST /api/appointments accepted a booking for 09:00 today AND for a date 3 days in the past (both returned 200 confirmed, with 24h/1h reminders scheduled in the past). Filter elapsed slots for today and reject appointment_date/time <= now.

minor.issue: allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True permits credentialed requests from any origin; the CORS_ORIGINS env var is defined in backend/.env but never read. Restrict to explicit origins before production.

Fresh-database seed hashes demo passwords as 'CareSync123!' while /app/memory/test_credentials.md, PRD and all docs say 'CareFlow123!'. Existing preview DB still works (seed short-circuits when users exist), but a clean deploy will have credentials that do not match the documented ones.
Admin release queue returns every report with no pagination/limit; will not scale (patient/doctor lists are also unbounded).

ui_bugs.issue: Renders `item.doctor_name||item.patient_name`, so a doctor's own 'Appointments' list shows the doctor's own name on every row ('Dr. Sarah Mehta' x N) instead of the patient name. Should show patient_name for doctor/admin viewers.

Uses appointments[0] from a list sorted ascending by date, so it displays the OLDEST record - on the admin dashboard it showed a cancelled 21-Aug (past) appointment as 'Today's schedule'. Should pick the next future non-cancelled appointment.

Success and error text share the same node/testid `booking-confirmation` (message state is reused for the 409 error), so automation/screen readers cannot distinguish a confirmed booking from a failure.

issues: The upload panel and 'My submissions' rows are 3px (390px) / 18px (375px) wider than the viewport (panel left=16, right=393) and are clipped by body{overflow-x:hidden}: the card's right border and right padding are visually cut off. Fix the width/padding math (e.g. width:100% + box-sizing on .upload-panel/.admin-row inside .main).
Document title is still 'Emergent | Fullstack App' and meta description 'A product of emergent.sh'; product name in UI should be CareSync.
Eyebrow label reads 'CAREFLOW / LEGAL' - last visible legacy product-name string in the UI; should read 'CARESYNC / LEGAL'.
Raw DB enum shown to users: rows read 'demo_patient · patient_visible' / '· private'. Use human labels ('Released to patient' / 'Private').
From/To use native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than the available shadcn calendar/date-picker; inconsistent with the rest of the design system.
'Block these dates' button visually overhangs the bottom-right corner of its panel at 1920px.

action_items: HIGH: reject past dates/times in POST /api/appointments and filter elapsed slots out of GET /api/slots for today's date (also skip creating already-past reminders).
Show patient_name (not doctor_name) on appointment cards for doctor/admin viewers.
Dashboard 'Next up' should select the next upcoming non-cancelled appointment, not appointments[0].
Fix /app/uploads mobile width overflow (3-18px clipped card edge).
Rename 'CAREFLOW / LEGAL' eyebrow to CareSync and set index.html <title>/description to CareSync.
Align seed() demo password with the documented CareFlow123! (currently CareSync123! on a fresh DB).
Restrict CORS to explicit origins (use the existing unused CORS_ORIGINS env var) instead of allow_origin_regex='.*' with credentials.
Humanise the visibility labels in the admin release queue and separate success/error testids in the booking dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a dense single file (492 very long lines); routes/auth/storage/notifications should be split into modules for maintainability, and one-line multi-statement bodies make diffs/debugging hard.
No time validation anywhere in the booking path - slots() only checks weekday rules, exceptions and existing bookings; add a `now()` cutoff.
release_report writes released_at=None when visibility flips back to private/archived, silently discarding audit history; consider keeping an audit trail instead.
reminder_loop has no try/except around the DB work; a transient Mongo error will kill the background task for the process lifetime (no restart/backoff).
GET /api/reports, /api/appointments, /api/patient-documents return unbounded lists (no limit/skip); notifications is the only capped query (30).
uvicorn --reload watches /app/backend/tests, so writing test files restarts the API; harmless for QA but worth knowing when timing tests.

success_rate.backend: 100% (19/19 pytest, 2 consecutive runs) - excluding the past-date defect found by targeted probing
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all 7 UI scenarios pass; 1 mobile clipping + 3 cosmetic/logic display issues)

seed_data_creation: No new users. Temporary artifacts created and removed: TEST_QA_final_report / TEST_QA_UI_report reports, TEST_QA_patient_doc patient document, TEST_qa_* availability exceptions, and a handful of TEST appointments (cancelled, rows kept for history). Cleanup also removed 9 stale TEST* reports and 21 stale TEST* patient_documents left by earlier iterations, plus the probe's login_attempts row. Current DB: 2 reports, 4 patient documents, 0 exceptions, appointments 8 confirmed / 3 needs_rescheduling / 49 cancelled (mostly historic QA data - consider a demo-data reset before deploy).
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is accurate for the running preview DB (all seeded @careflow.demo accounts / CareFlow123!). NOTE: seed() would create CareSync123! on a fresh database - mismatch flagged above.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run only /app/backend/tests/test_final_qa.py for regression (19 cases, ~11s, classes are xdist-loadscope safe; each class cleans up after itself). Known open defect: past-dated/elapsed slot bookings are accepted (reproduce with /app/backend/tests/probe_past_slot.py). UI nav testids are label-derived: patient = navigation-find-a-doctor/appointments/my-records/my-uploads; doctor = navigation-my-schedule (appointments) and navigation-availability (weekly editor); admin = navigation-reports (AdminReports) and navigation-availability. The slot duration control is a native <select> (use select_option, not fill). `[data-testid^="notification-"]` also matches notification-center-link - use div.notification for rows. Emergent object storage is live: uploads return storage_backend='emergent' with careflow/ prefix and downloads are byte-exact.
rca_of_the_issue: Past-booking defect RCA: slots() (server.py:315) builds the slot grid purely from weekday availability rules, exception ranges and existing bookings, and book() (server.py:337) only re-checks that the requested time appears as available in that grid. Neither compares appointment_date/appointment_time against now(), so today's elapsed times and any historical date remain bookable; the reminder rows created afterwards are already in the past and are fired immediately by reminder_loop. Fix: in slots(), when appointment_date == today's UTC date, drop labels whose start <= now; in book(), 400 if the composed datetime is not in the future.
